caption:
Your shower curtain clings to your leg every time.

That clinging happens because steam and water pull a thin curtain inward, and it sticks to wet skin instead of hanging flat. Cheap liners also pick up a cloudy yellow tint after enough showers, which makes the whole bathroom look dingy even when it's clean.

A plain clear vinyl curtain is built to do one simple job: hang flat against the rod and let light through instead of fighting you in the shower. It stays basic and see-through on purpose, so there's less going on for steam to grab onto.

You get a curtain that looks clean and stays out of your way, for about $12.
